s.note: Giuseppe plays Jump Man. Garlic knots.
s.how: Roll the dough into 12 ropes and tie each one in a loose knot. Bake on a lined tray at 220C until golden. Stir the garlic and parsley into the melted butter and brush it over the hot knots. Scatter with parmesan and serve with the warmed marinara.

Soften the onion in the butter, stir in the rice, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time until creamy and tender. Stir in the parmesan, spread on a tray and cool completely. Roll into balls around a cube of mozzarella, then coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs. Fry in oil at 180C until deep golden. Simmer the passata with the chilli and serve as a dip.

m.n: Red and green pepper Brooklyn pizza
m.note: Their TV ad plays here. Half red, half green.
m.how: Heat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside. Stretch the dough into 2 large rounds and spread with sauce. Scatter with mozzarella, then red capsicum on one half and green on the other, and the oregano. Bake on the hot tray until blistered and bubbling. Finish with basil and a drizzle of oil.

m.note: Spike calls them favourite failures. Meatballs, red sauce, provolone.
m.how: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and half the garlic and roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in a hot pan, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic and simmer until cooked through. Split the rolls, pile in the meatballs and sauce and lay over the provolone. Grill until the cheese melts, then add basil and serve.

w.note: Told ya I'd get you a pet turtle. Blue icing, white chocolate spots.
w.how: Beat 150g butter and the sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, milk and vanilla and spoon into 12 lined cupcake cases. Bake at 180C until springy, then cool. Beat the rest of the butter with the icing sugar and blue colouring, then dome it on each cupcake. Press on white chocolate melts for the mushroom spots.
shop: 150g soft butter, plus 125g for the icing@Dairy

d.note: Bowser sings Peaches. Peach iced tea, lemon and mint.
d.how: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water, then stir in the honey and cool. Mix the cold tea with the peach nectar. Pour over ice with lemon slices and mint.

shopping: 150g soft butter, plus 125g for the icing@Dairy
